en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small riverside town with a stone multi‑arch bridge crossing a river in the foreground. A horse‑drawn carriage is moving across the bridge. On the far bank stand several multi‑storey traditional buildings and houses, with gently rolling, cultivated hills and fields in the background. At the top left in red Gothic‑style script is a printed caption identifying the place.
